title: Aggregate saved records into a payment state
description: Verifies that saved order or report records can be loaded by index and combined into a payment state.

steps.description: Navigate to /pagos.html
Enter a saved record index number
Load the record into the payment state
Enter another saved record index number
Load the second record into the payment state
Verify the aggregated hours and amounts are displayed
Verify the loaded records are included in the payment state

title: Calculate and view a single work order total
description: Verifies that a user can complete a work order calculation and see the expected service and total breakdown.

steps.description: Navigate to /ordenes.html
Select a day type
Fill a valid start time into the start time field
Fill a valid end time into the end time field
Select an hourly rate
Select a surcharge percentage
Select minimum guaranteed hours
Click to calculate the work order
Verify the detailed service breakdown is displayed
Verify the total cost result is displayed

title: Calculate and save a weekly report
description: Verifies that a user can build a weekly report, review totals, and save it locally with an index.

steps.description: Navigate to /reportes.html
Fill valid times into one or more day rows
Select the included days
Set the global hourly rate
Set the global surcharge percentage
Set the global minimum guaranteed hours
Click to calculate the weekly report
Verify the consolidated weekly totals are displayed
Fill a unique index number into the index field
Click to save the report
Verify a saved report confirmation is visible

title: Save a calculated work order with an index
description: Verifies that a calculated work order can be saved locally with an index number.

steps.description: Navigate to /ordenes.html
Select a day type
Fill a valid start time into the start time field
Fill a valid end time into the end time field
Select an hourly rate
Select a surcharge percentage
Select minimum guaranteed hours
Click to calculate the work order
Fill a unique index number into the index field
Click to save the record
Verify a saved record confirmation is visible

title: Add extra costs and company details before generating liquidation
description: Verifies that extra cost items and company information are reflected in the payment state before liquidation is generated.

steps.description: Navigate to /pagos.html
Enter a saved record index number
Load the record into the payment state
Add an extra cost item name
Fill a quantity for the extra cost item
Fill a unit price for the extra cost item
Fill the company name field
Fill the company address field
Fill the company contact field
Enter a logo URL
Verify the updated payment totals with IVA are displayed

title: View stored records in history
description: A user can open the history page and see previously saved records listed for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Verify stored records are displayed in the history table

title: Generate a printable liquidation from saved records
description: Verifies that a payment state built from saved records can generate a printable liquidation view.

steps.description: Navigate to /pagos.html
Enter a saved record index number
Load the record into the payment state
Click to generate the liquidation
Verify a printable liquidation is displayed

title: Search for a record by index
description: A user can search the history by index number and see the matching record in the results.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Fill in a saved record index in the search field
Verify the matching record is displayed in the filtered history results

title: Filter history by record type
description: A user can filter the history to show only order records or only report records.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Select a record type filter
Verify only records of the selected type are displayed

title: Calculate a weekly report using selected days only
description: Verifies that only the included days contribute to the weekly totals in the report.

steps.description: Navigate to /reportes.html
Fill valid times into two or more day rows
Select only some of the available days as included
Set the global hourly rate
Set the global surcharge percentage
Set the global minimum guaranteed hours
Click to calculate the weekly report
Verify the weekly totals reflect only the included days

title: Open a record details modal
description: A user can open a saved record from history and inspect its details in a modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Open a saved record from the history table
Verify the record details modal is displayed
Verify the record details are visible in the modal

title: Search and inspect a saved record in history
description: Verifies that a user can find a stored record in history and open its details in the modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Enter a search term or index filter
Apply the filter
Open a matching record in the details modal
Verify the record details modal is displayed
Verify the selected record information is displayed

title: Modify a saved record from history
description: Verifies that a record opened from history can be edited and saved back to local storage.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Open a saved record in the details modal
Choose to edit the record
Update a record field
Save the changes
Verify a record updated confirmation is visible

title: Delete a saved record from history
description: A user can delete a saved record from history after confirming the action and see it removed from the table.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Delete a saved record from the history table
Confirm the deletion
Verify the deleted record is no longer displayed in history

title: Import and merge JSON records into history
description: A user can import a JSON file containing records and merge the imported items into the existing history.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Import a valid JSON file of records
Verify the imported records are added to the history table
Verify existing records remain available after the import

title: Reset a work order form after changes
description: Verifies that clearing the work order form returns it to its initial empty state.

steps.description: Navigate to /ordenes.html
Select a day type
Fill a valid start time into the start time field
Fill a valid end time into the end time field
Select an hourly rate
Click to clear the work order form
Verify the form fields are reset
Verify no calculated results are displayed

title: Export history as JSON
description: A user can export the stored history as a JSON file from the history page.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Export the stored records as JSON
Verify the export action completes and the history remains visible

title: Export and reimport stored history records
description: Verifies that stored records can be exported to JSON and then imported back into local history as a merge operation.

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Export the stored records to JSON
Import the exported records back into history
Verify the imported records appear in history
Verify the existing history remains available after import

title: Show validation when weekly report data is incomplete
description: Verifies that the weekly report calculator does not produce totals when required day or rate data is missing.

Select at least one included day without entering complete times
Set the global hourly rate
Click to calculate the weekly report
Verify a report validation error is visible
Verify no weekly totals are displayed

title: Show validation when a work order time range is invalid
description: Verifies that an invalid work order time range is rejected and no calculation result is produced.

steps.description: Navigate to /ordenes.html
Select a day type
Fill a start time later than the end time into the time fields
Select an hourly rate
Click to calculate the work order
Verify a time validation error is visible
Verify no calculation results are displayed

title: Handle an empty history state

steps.description: Navigate to /historial.html
Verify an empty state message is displayed when no records are saved

description: Verifies that entering a nonexistent saved record index in payments does not load any record.

steps.description: Navigate to /pagos.html
Enter a nonexistent record index number
Load the record into the payment state

Verify no payment state is loaded
